answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 12834 Country: Canada Title: Is it permissible to perform salaah in stained clothing? Question: Is it permissible to perform salaah in stained clothing? Answer ID: 12834 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 783/783=M/1430) If the cloth was not stained with any impure thing, you can offer salah therein. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
